responsibility: Declares the public backend interfaces for the MicroBlaze port that are shared across the target header, machine description support code, and C frontend hook. The prototypes cover address legitimacy and PIC/TLS helpers, prologue/epilogue and frame layout routines, argument passing, move/shift/divide/block-move expanders, branch expansion, operand printing, register allocation helpers, EH return support, and the MicroBlaze preprocessor builtin entry point.
